name: Swarm check
description: Conformance fixture for the Swarm provider's integration points: unified sheet, publish, feeds, the publish hook.

private.why: Stores a test file whose bytes are then published, to check the publish hook.

publish.why: Publishes a small test blob using your postage.

feeds.why: Creates a test feed and writes one entry to it.

signing.why: Reads the signing identity the feed will use.

messaging.why: Opens one GSOC subscription and sends one message to it.
